The Black Hinge-Booking Form
Name of Main Act
The Rick Candies
Musical Genre
Rhythm and Blues
Date(s) of Performance(s)
April 29
Contact Name
Santiago Martinez
Contact E-mail
smartinez@rapidonet.com
Main acts must arrange their own opening acts.
DJ Cosmic Center, techno music
Who will your opening act be?
Questions or special requests?
Do you offer any services or
amenities? We would like dressing
rooms for both the main act and
the opening act.
To:
Santiago Martinez <smartinez@rapidonet.com>
From:
Yuko Miura <ymiura@theblackhinge.com>
Subject:
Booking your performance
Date:
January 17
Dear Santiago,
We've received your booking form and are delighted to welcome The Rick Candies to The
Black Hinge on April 29! Regarding your special request, we can only accommodate the
main act.
Here are some show details to note:
• Performance time at The Black Hinge is 7-11 P.M.
• The desired stage-time split is up to the main and opening acts, but typically the opening
act plays 7-8 P.M. and the main act plays 8:30-11 P.M.
• Regarding payment, you may choose one of the following two options:
1. A $300 flat payment to be divided among the two musical acts as they see fit.
2. The proceeds of a $10-per-guest cover charge. Acts may keep the money collected at
the door minus a 10% fee, which will be paid to the person who collects the cover charge
from guests. This person will be provided by The Black Hinge.
• We can provide a table for you to sell your band's merchandise, but no staff from The
Black Hinge will be available to supervise the table.
Sincerely,
Yuko Miura
THE RICK CANDIES
featuring special guest DJ Cosmic Center
April 29 @ The Black Hinge, Chicago
Cover Charge: $10
7-8 P.M.: DJ Cosmic Center
8:30-11 P.M.: The Rick Candies
Join us for an unforgettable night with The Rick Candies, four soulful rhythm and blues
performers from Peoria. The quartet takes its inspiration from the legends who pioneered
the music we love. Come early to hear DJ Cosmic Center kick things off with an eclectic
techno music set. Merchandise will be available for sale after the show.
context.passage_translation:
黑铰链-预订表
主要表演者名称：The Rick Candies
音乐类型：节奏布鲁斯
演出日期：4月29日
联系人：Santiago Martinez
联系电子邮件：smartinez@rapidonet.com
主表演者必须自行安排开场表演。
DJ Cosmic Center，Techno 音乐
您的开场表演是谁？
问题或特殊要求？
您提供任何服务或设施吗？我们需要为主表演和开场表演都准备更衣室。
致：Santiago Martinez <smartinez@rapidonet.com>
自：Yuko Miura <ymiura@theblackhinge.com>
主题：预订您的演出
日期：1月17日
尊敬的 Santiago：
我们收到了您的预订表，并很高兴地欢迎 The Rick Candies 在 4 月 29 日在 The Black Hinge 演出！关于您的特殊要求，我们只能满足主表演者的需求。
以下是需要注意的一些演出细节：
• The Black Hinge 的演出时间为下午 7 点至晚上 11 点。
• 期望的舞台时间分配是给主表演和开场表演的，但通常开场表演在下午 7 点到 8 点，主表演在晚上 8:30 到 11 点。
• 关于付款，您可以选择以下两种方案之一：
1. 向两个音乐团体支付 300 美元的固定费用，由他们自行分配。
2. 按每位客人 10 美元收取门票收入。表演团体可以保留门票收入减去 10% 的费用，这笔费用将支付给从客人们那里收取门票费的人。此人将由 The Black Hinge 提供。
• 我们可以为您提供一个销售乐队商品的桌子，但 The Black Hinge 的工作人员不会在场监督该桌子。
诚挚地，
Yuko Miura
THE RICK CANDIES
特别嘉宾 DJ Cosmic Center
4月29日 @ The Black Hinge, Chicago
门票：10 美元
下午 7-8 点：DJ Cosmic Center
晚上 8:30-11 点：The Rick Candies
与 The Rick Candies 一起度过一个难忘的夜晚，他们是来自 Peoria 的四位充满灵魂的节奏布鲁斯表演者。这个四人组合从开创了我们所喜爱音乐的传奇人物那里汲取灵感。请提早前来，聆听 DJ Cosmic Center 以一场折衷的 Techno 音乐演出开启气氛。演出结束后将有商品出售。
